_about: Superheroes: powers, secret identities, the cost of being a hero, and a city to protect. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

power_source: a lab accident that should have killed them
a meteor shard sewn into their skin
a spirit bound to them at a shrine in chiang mai
an inheritance passed down a family line
an experimental drug from a failed trial
a pact with something that lives in mirrors
a suit built in a garage from scrap
a mutation that showed up at puberty
price: the power grows and they are losing control
someone they love feels their pain
they age a day for every minute of use
it only works when they are angry
villain_want: to prove heroes make the city worse
to bring back a dead child
to own the city's water and power
to be seen, finally, by the public
to free everyone with powers from the law
to undo the accident that made the hero
to burn down the company that ruined them
to take the hero's place and be loved
city: a neon port city that never stops building
a rust-belt town where the factories closed
a glittering capital run by one corporation
a harbor city in the philippines with a famous bridge
a desert boomtown built too fast
an old river city with a corrupt police force
a city rebuilt after the last super-fight
identity_risk: a journalist who is getting close
a little sibling who found the costume
a boss who notices every absence
a partner who thinks they are cheating
a doctor who treated the hero's wounds
a villain who already knows and waits
a teacher who recognized their voice
public_view: the hero is blamed for the last disaster
kids wear the hero's mask to school
the city council wants them banned
a tabloid runs a hero ranking every week
the police hate them, the people love them
a rival hero is the city's favorite

cliches: the origin story told again in full
the villain falls into a vat
a death that is undone next issue
the love interest kidnapped to a rooftop
